name: MND Australia
eligibility: People affected by MND, carers, families, clinicians and support workers.
description: National information and links to state MND associations, resources and advocacy.

name: Carer Gateway
description: Carer counselling, coaching, peer support, respite and emergency respite pathways.

name: MND NSW
region: New South Wales, ACT and Northern Territory
eligibility: People with MND or Kennedy's disease, family carers and eligible support users.
description: MND advisors, intake, information, equipment pathways, support groups and links with MND clinics.

name: MND Queensland
eligibility: Queenslanders impacted by MND, families and carers.
description: Specialist MND support, health advisors, NDIS navigation, therapy, equipment hire and support groups.

name: MND South Australia
eligibility: South Australians living with MND, carers, families and friends.
description: Information, education, support coordination, counselling, service coordination and aged care pathway support.

name: MND Victoria Equipment Service
eligibility: Equipment requests submitted by an appropriate allied health professional.
description: NDIS registered assistive technology provider with equipment request processes and equipment factsheets.

name: MND Victoria
region: Victoria, Tasmania and border areas of NSW
eligibility: People affected by MND or Kennedy's disease, families, carers, community workers and health professionals.
description: Support services, MND Guides, equipment service, carer and family support, support groups, education and volunteer support.

name: MND Western Australia
eligibility: Western Australians impacted by MND, families and carers.
description: MND advisory service, support coordination, respiratory physiotherapy, equipment, occupational therapy, education and support groups.

name: Carers Australia
eligibility: Unpaid carers, carer organisations and policy/service stakeholders.
description: National peak body representing Australia's unpaid carers, with information and links to Carer Gateway and state carer organisations.

name: Healthdirect Australia
eligibility: People in Australia seeking health information or service navigation.
description: 24-hour health information service and health service finder, including information on MND and caring for others.
